nodes.prompt: Photorealistic vertical 9:16 photo, the first frame of a video shot, looking like an ordinary frame from a real camera with a normal lens, not a render; true-to-life gentle colors and soft natural contrast; fine natural grain; the far background a touch softer than the foreground. No over-sharpening, no HDR, no CGI look. Image 1 is the empty kitchen at night: the shot takes place in exactly this room, same furniture, same light; keep the background exactly as in Image 1. Image 2 is the character sheet of the grandmother: use it only for the face, hair, glasses, jewelry and clothes. Image 3 shows the teal silicone utensils: use it only for their shape and teal color. Medium shot. The photo shows at night in her kitchen the grandmother stands at the trash can with a plate and fork in her hands, the white ceramic crock of teal silicone utensils on the counter beside the old white gas range. The grandmother: a 71-year-old Black American woman, healthy, quick-witted and capable, warm brown skin, soft natural wrinkles, short tapered natural silver hair neatly styled, reading glasses on a chain, small gold earrings, a small gold cross necklace, a thin gold wedding band. She looks like the proud matriarch of her family, never frail. She wears a copper-colored silk blouse, a pearl necklace, a cream cardigan and a floral cotton apron. Anyone holding something: the right number of fingers, a natural grip, exactly two arms and two hands per person, no extra hands; nothing floats. Everyone's eyes stay off-lens; nobody looks into the camera. Look: night, the kitchen lit only by the warm yellow range-hood light, the rest of the room falling into soft shadow, quiet and tense. Skin as a real camera sees it from a couple of meters away: natural, with subtle texture and slight unevenness, not retouched, not over-detailed; no airbrushed, waxy or plastic skin. Final check: the grandmother is the same person as in the character sheet, with the same clothes, glasses and jewelry. No subtitles, no captions, no on-screen text.

Medium shot, 6 seconds, one continuous shot, no cuts. The image is the start frame; the shot begins exactly on it. Camera: standing on a tripod, locked off, no movement. Physics: real weight and balance; people move at a real-time pace. Object lock: every utensil, bowl, plate, glass, brochure and prop in the picture is a rigid solid object that keeps exactly the same shape, size, length, color and number of pieces from the first frame to the last; nothing bends, stretches, melts, warps, splits, merges, multiplies, morphs or turns into something else; nothing appears, disappears or swaps places. The grandmother starts speaking at about 1.0 seconds and has finished the whole line by about 4.2 seconds at the latest; then stays silent. Everyone else stays silent.
